title: Dad Won't Open My PRESENT 🎁
description:
In our town, a wrapped present is whatever you hope it is. Mrs. Albee next door says her shoebox is the circus, and you can hear a tuba when she shakes it. Nobody opens anything.

There's a present on my dad's mantel from me. It's been there twelve years. I know exactly what's in it.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment HOME if you'd have hoped for the same thing.
